title: Vocabulary Arcade
description: One word set, five ways to practise: matching, clues, swiping, scrambling, and flashcards.
grade_note: The teacher selects the vocabulary or word families. Adaptable across grades; no fixed outcome coverage is claimed by the tool itself.

title: Writer Spark
description: Choose a story starter, map ideas, organise a narrative, or freewrite. Save and reopen your project as you develop it.
credit: MacGregor Maltais Magic Writer Spark
grade_note: Narrative planning, drafting, revising and sustained writing are the best fit. Younger learners can use selected prompts with teacher support.

title: InfoSpark
description: Gather facts, statistics and quotes, then build informational or persuasive writing one paragraph at a time.
credit: MacGregor Maltais InfoSpark
grade_note: The fact/evidence board and paragraph structures support informational writing; persuasive options are particularly relevant in Grades 5–6.

title: Rooting For You!
description: Reveal roots, use context clues, and work out what a whole word means. Complete a 20-word journey and revisit words you found tricky.
grade_note: Word origins support Grade 5 vocabulary; Greek and Latin roots are explicit Grade 6 content. Not all word-part knowledge is taught by this one game.

title: Vretta Type PAT Practice
description: Practise Alberta Grade 6 science in English or French across all five units, with original PAT-style questions, pictures, drag-and-drop, learning and test modes. Independent of Vretta.
grade_note: Grade 6 science practice; individual units and questions need a separate outcome coverage audit.

title: Float Lab
description: Compare density, layer seven liquids, suspend an oil drop, and design a floating hull. Make predictions, test ideas, and compare saved trials.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Alberta Grade 5 Science: compare the density of solids and liquids, relate buoyant force and weight to floating and sinking, conduct controlled experiments, and refine a floating design. Partial connections to Matter, Energy, Scientific Methods and Design; physical measuring and construction need hands-on practice.

title: Moon Phase Lab
description: Move one Moon around Earth, watch the view from Earth change, then match and name the phases.
grade_note: The model and phase naming directly support lunar-cycle content; it does not teach the whole space outcome.

title: GeoTrek
description: Travel from one country to another by choosing neighbouring countries. Use clues to plan your route.
original_title: GeoTrek. This is a fun way to learn countries that isn't just identification.
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: Mackwood Mapping
description: Choose a region and identify countries by clicking the map. Track your progress through the challenge.
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: World Subregion Challenge
description: Study countries by world region or smaller subregion, then test yourself on the map. Includes a separate Middle East region and shuffled challenges.
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: Thinking & Dialogue
description: Try Socratic Dialogue: a guided conversation built around curious questions. Explore 16 thinking and discussion activities with teacher scripts, student prompts and printable guides for any subject.
grade_note: Teacher-selected ideas, images, terms and questions determine the grade and subject. The comparison/discussion tool alone does not cover a curriculum outcome.

title: Thinking Routines
description: Choose a Social Studies outcome and lesson phase, then find a routine with a ready-to-use teacher process.
grade_note: Teacher routine companions are provided for each grade. Actual coverage depends on the chosen outcome, lesson content and student task.

title: Cashier Change Challenge
description: Calculate change using real Canadian bills and coins. Work through eight transactions with drag, tap or keyboard controls and an optional timer.
grade_note: The main challenge uses dollars/cents and subtraction of decimal money amounts.

title: WordWorks Lab
description: Solve eight meaning clues by combining prefixes, base words and suffixes. Choose from three Word Quest levels, use hints and discover spelling changes.
grade_note: Choose the level and words: prefixes/suffixes begin in Grade 3, with more complex meanings and derivation in later grades.

title: Word Orbit
description: Drag floating prefixes and suffixes onto a base word. Collect 213 words across 23 families, from pony → ponies to readable → readability. Grow word chains, learn spelling changes, and watch completed branches pop back to the base.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Focused, partial ELAL 1–6 practice: plural and tense endings, comparisons, meaningful prefixes, person-naming and adjective endings, and later derivations such as -ment, -ity, -ance, -ence, -en and -ize. The bank includes the spreadsheet’s pony–ponies and leaf–leaves examples. Choose familiar families with adult support for early readers; this is not complete coverage of every affix or outcome.

title: Word Ladders
description: Climb 65 original six-word ladders: 20 each in Starter, Explorer and Expert, plus five Extreme challenges with advanced vocabulary. Follow meaning clues or find your own route. Teachers can download worksheets or level PDF packs, with optional separate answer keys.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Focused ELAL 1–6 vocabulary and spelling practice through original meaning clues and single-letter word changes. The three grade bands are flexible suggestions; choose by learner needs. Letter changes and sound changes are discussed separately in teacher notes.

title: Double Take
description: Collect word stickers across 72 context challenges. Choose sound-alike spellings or explore different meanings of the same written word. Three difficulty levels, read-aloud support, teacher PDFs and an offline copy.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Focused ELAL vocabulary practice: homophones, homographs, multiple meanings, spelling–meaning connections and evidence from context. The three difficulty bands are flexible suggestions, with adult support where needed.

title: Literal Chaos
description: Decode 36 expressions through context, then build a two-panel comic with movable props, original captions and a figurative meaning. Three difficulty levels, five language focuses, read-aloud, printable practice and offline copies.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Flexible figurative-language practice and original comic creation. Difficulty bands are suggestions; teachers can choose expressions and provide reading support. The open comic task invites explanations and several defensible interpretations.

title: Word Worlds
description: Change the words and direct a living paper world. Compare two interpretations across three settings, explore 12 open challenges, and explain how language shapes mood. Responsive animation and sound, a student gallery, comparison PDFs and an offline copy.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Flexible creative-language tool for exploring word choice, setting, mood, personification and viewpoint. The scene offers one authored interpretation; students can challenge it and support different readings. The 12 prompts are open experiments, not graded outcomes.

title: Print & Play Cards
description: Choose alphabet pictures or sight words, preview the primary writing lines, and print practice pages.
grade_note: Alphabet and early high-frequency word options support beginning literacy; the custom word list can be adapted beyond these grades.

title: Accessible Periodic Table
description: Search elements, hear their names and details, and switch to large element cards.
grade_note: Element names, atomic numbers and periodic-table information support matter study. This is a reference, not a complete chemistry lesson.

title: Space Arcade
description: Read, move sticky notes, sort evidence, weigh choices, and build a mission plan across eight activities.
grade_note: The built-in space reading and evidence tasks are designed around Grade 4 objects in space and daily life.

title: Water Cycle Explorer
description: Explore water pathways on an illustrated landscape, then try labelling the cycle yourself.
grade_note: Labelling the cycle directly supports Grade 3 changes of state and provides a model for the Grade 7 water-cycle connection to life.

title: Fraction Explorer
description: Build and compare fractions with large colour-coded models, choose <, = or >, find common denominators, and practise simplifying, operations and BEDMAS.
grade_note: Use comparison and like-denominator work in Grade 5, unlike-denominator operations in Grade 6, and fraction multiplication/division in Grade 7.

title: HEX-Thinker
description: Add your own terms, move the hexagons, and explain connections between ideas.
credit: By Greg Gowens
grade_note: Teacher-selected ideas, images, terms and questions determine the grade and subject. The comparison/discussion tool alone does not cover a curriculum outcome.

title: Association Triangle
description: Connect three terms, quotes, or images. Explain each relationship and bring the ideas together.
credit: By Greg Gowens
grade_note: Teacher-selected ideas, images, terms and questions determine the grade and subject. The comparison/discussion tool alone does not cover a curriculum outcome.

title: Canadian Geography: Local Places
description: Start in your community, then follow direction clues to find Canadian places. Use the map or place list, take hints, and explore freely.
grade_note: Directional clues and relative location connect to Grade 2 mapping. Pirate grid references are an additional map-skill activity, not a complete Cartesian-plane lesson.

title: Pirate Mapping
description: Follow compass clues, three-stop trails or grid references. Steer across the original island map and collect five hidden treasures.
grade_note: Directional clues and relative location connect to Grade 2 mapping. Pirate grid references are an additional map-skill activity, not a complete Cartesian-plane lesson.

title: Canada Fact Finder
description: Click a province or territory to discover facts about it.
original_title: Canadian Provinces and Territories Fact Finder
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Provinces & Territories Map Challenge
description: Read a clue and find the correct province or territory on the map.
original_title: Canadian Provinces and Territories Map Challenge
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Alberta Regions & Subregions
description: Explore Alberta’s natural regions and the subregions within them.
grade_note: Alberta’s physical features and regions are explicit Grade 3 content. Subregions can extend the major-region comparison.

title: Alberta Regions Explorer
description: Use a simpler regional map to explore Alberta’s major natural regions.
grade_note: Alberta’s physical features and regions are explicit Grade 3 content. Subregions can extend the major-region comparison.

title: Alberta Regions Quiz
description: Explore, quiz, or practise identifying Alberta’s natural regions.
grade_note: Alberta’s physical features and regions are explicit Grade 3 content. Subregions can extend the major-region comparison.

title: Canada’s Physiographic Regions
description: Explore the physical regions that shape Canada’s landscape.
grade_note: Canada’s physical regions are an explicit Grade 2 topic; use maps to compare regions, not only memorize names.

title: Canada’s Regions Quiz
description: Use explore, quiz, and practice modes to learn Canada’s physical regions.
grade_note: Canada’s physical regions are an explicit Grade 2 topic; use maps to compare regions, not only memorize names.

title: Place Names of Alberta
description: Investigate the stories and origins behind Alberta place names.
grade_note: The place-name stories and community languages support Alberta identity and historically significant places.

title: Provinces, Territories & Capitals
description: Explore and practise Canada’s provinces, territories, and capital cities.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Label Canada
description: Drag province and territory labels onto the correct places on the map.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Mixed-Up Canada Puzzle
description: Move the province and territory pieces to put Canada back together.
original_title: Mixed up Map of Canada Digital Puzzle
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Learn the Countries of the World
description: Explore countries, answer map questions, and practise by world region.
original_title: Learn the Countries of the World
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: Label the Countries of the World
description: Drag country names onto the map and work through smaller regions.
original_title: Label the Countries of the World
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: CanadaTrek
description: Travel between provinces, territories, or capitals using neighbouring places.
original_title: CanadaTrek. A version for provinces, territories, and capitals.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Continents Identification
description: Use the world map to identify and practise the continents.
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: Latitude & Longitude
description: Explore a labelled world grid, find eight target coordinates, and use north/south/east/west feedback to improve each location.
grade_note: Latitude and longitude are explicitly named in Grade 5 descriptions of civilization locations; this activity practises the coordinate skill.

title: US States
description: Explore, quiz, and practise identifying US states on the map.
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: US States GeoTrek
description: Build a route between states by choosing neighbouring states.
grade_note: General world, continent or US location practice. The supplied workbooks do not assign these full country/state lists to a particular grade; teachers can pair the maps with grade-specific studies.

title: Geo Colouring Page
description: Open a map outline and print a colouring page for classroom use.
original_title: Geo Coloring Page. this can be used to make black lines of any geojson file
grade_note: Alberta’s physical features and regions are explicit Grade 3 content. Subregions can extend the major-region comparison.

title: Alberta Colouring Template
description: Open the editable Google Slides template for Alberta’s regions.
grade_note: Alberta’s physical features and regions are explicit Grade 3 content. Subregions can extend the major-region comparison.

title: Provinces & Territories Colouring Template
description: Open the editable Google Slides template for Canada’s provinces and territories.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Canada Regions Colouring Template
description: Open the editable Google Slides template for Canada’s physical regions.
grade_note: Canada’s physical regions are an explicit Grade 2 topic; use maps to compare regions, not only memorize names.

title: Numbered Treaties of Canada
description: Explore numbered treaty areas and read the information shown for each.
grade_note: Grade 3 locates Alberta treaties; Grade 7 connects numbered treaties to post-Confederation state building. A treaty-area map alone does not teach the full treaty relationship.

title: Grade 3 Treaty Explorer
description: Zoom in on treaty areas and use the map to gather information for research.
grade_note: The Grade 3 edition is scaffolded for researching and locating Alberta treaty areas.

title: Canada Map Challenge
description: Read a province or territory clue, locate the answer, and ask for a hint when you need one.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Heart Word Mapper
description: Map sounds and mark the parts learned by heart. Practise a checked starter set or review and edit mappings from the full teacher library.
grade_note: Maps sounds and the unexpected spellings in high-frequency words; also useful for intervention at other ages.

title: Sound, Structure, Spell
description: Explore a spelling pattern through word sorts, listening, analogies, and sentence writing.
grade_note: The fixed vowel-consonant-e lessons directly match early vowel and spelling-pattern content.

title: Sentence Building
description: Print cut-and-paste word cards to build sentences, then check capitals, punctuation and meaning.
grade_note: The default simple sentence strips support sentence structure, capitals and punctuation. Entered sentences can be adjusted by the teacher.

title: Reading Maze Printables
description: Print reading passages for a timed word-choice assessment in context, with directions for administering and scoring.
credit: CORE Reading Maze · Michael Milone
grade_note: The supplied printable explicitly contains Grade 2–10 passage sets. Only Grades 2–6 have been cross-checked against the requested ELAL workbook; Grades 7–10 are the resource author’s labels.

title: Boreal Forest Comprehension
description: Investigate energy and nutrients in Alberta’s boreal forest. Select five key ideas, explain their importance, and check your understanding.
grade_note: The supplied reading explores ecosystem components, energy and nutrients. Its science topic fit is Grade 6; comprehension use can be adapted separately.

title: Ecosystems Annotation
description: Read an ecosystems passage and mark evidence using the annotation tools.
grade_note: The supplied reading explores ecosystem components, energy and nutrients. Its science topic fit is Grade 6; comprehension use can be adapted separately.

title: Definition Draw
description: Draw a word’s meaning, compare it with the definition, and explain your thinking. Use undo and redo, import a set, or save your drawing.
grade_note: The teacher selects the vocabulary or word families. Adaptable across grades; no fixed outcome coverage is claimed by the tool itself.

title: Make Your Own Flashcards
description: Create or import your own term-and-definition deck. Flip cards, mark words to revisit, and export or print your set.
grade_note: The teacher selects the vocabulary or word families. Adaptable across grades; no fixed outcome coverage is claimed by the tool itself.

title: Vocabulary Match Builder
description: Enter term-and-definition pairs and export a vocabulary matching game for students.
grade_note: The teacher selects the vocabulary or word families. Adaptable across grades; no fixed outcome coverage is claimed by the tool itself.

title: Vocabulary Graphic Organiser
description: Explore a word through definitions, synonyms, antonyms and an example sentence.
grade_note: The teacher selects the vocabulary or word families. Adaptable across grades; no fixed outcome coverage is claimed by the tool itself.

title: Magnetic Morphology Boards
description: Reveal and explain the parts of 52 words, mark tricky words for review, or print the original paired challenge-and-answer boards.
grade_note: The supplied 52-word collection is labelled Grade 5 and includes bound roots, word origins and complex affixes that also support Grade 6.

title: Magnetic Morphology Flashcards
description: Practise 52 word constructions with meanings and spelling notes, then print two-sided cards for magnetic-letter word building.
grade_note: The supplied 52-word collection is labelled Grade 5 and includes bound roots, word origins and complex affixes that also support Grade 6.

title: Can I Have a Word?
description: Select word-part tiles to collect words across six families. Use clues, restart a family, or create and save a custom set with reachable targets.
grade_note: Select simple families for Grade 3 and more complex or bound-root families for Grades 4–6. Custom sets require teacher review.

title: Morpheme Match-Up
description: Build and collect words in four root families. Use collected words as new bases, investigate spelling changes, and choose an optional timed challenge.
grade_note: Select simple families for Grade 3 and more complex or bound-root families for Grades 4–6. Custom sets require teacher review.

title: Morpheme Game Generator
description: Load editable word-family clues, add meanings and spelling notes, then preview and download a student game you can open or share.
grade_note: The teacher selects the vocabulary or word families. Adaptable across grades; no fixed outcome coverage is claimed by the tool itself.

title: Dropdown Questions
description: Use source statements about rights and freedoms to choose answers from dropdown menus.
grade_note: The source-based dropdown questions practise Charter freedom of expression and reading speaker positions, rather than the complete rights or law-making outcomes.

title: Cacao Reading Questions
description: Read how cacao becomes chocolate and answer multiple-choice questions about the passage.
grade_note: The fixed informational passage and questions practise finding details and interpreting text. This is a reading task, not a complete ELAL outcome assessment.

title: Order the Cacao Steps
description: Drag the stages of making chocolate into the correct sequence, then check the order.
grade_note: The fixed cacao-processing sequence supports procedural reading and organizing information; explain unfamiliar process vocabulary as needed.

title: Interactive Math Task Cards
description: Flip maths task cards to check the answers and generate a new set of challenges.
grade_note: The built-in task-card set is Grade 4 arithmetic practice, not a full mathematics assessment.

title: Building & Breaking Numbers
description: Build, break and trade numbers with visual models. Each skill adapts independently, with a hands-on number lab and a teacher progress view.
grade_note: Composing, decomposing and regrouping natural numbers match Grades 2–3; choose a number range appropriate to the grade.

title: Number Sense · 29 Activities
description: A teacher-created mathematics collection with 29 interactive activities across six topics, plus three bonus mini-games. Build models, explore ideas, and practise at your own pace.
credit: Mrs. Publow & Mrs. Murley
grade_note: The teacher collection is principally Grade 6. Sub-activities include review and extension; not all listed Grade 6 outcomes are covered.

title: Science Practice Questions
description: Practise science questions in a game-style review with immediate answer feedback.
grade_note: Grade 6 science practice; individual units and questions need a separate outcome coverage audit.

title: Pratique des mathématiques
description: Review maths concepts through French-language practice questions.
grade_note: The teacher collection is principally Grade 6. Sub-activities include review and extension; not all listed Grade 6 outcomes are covered.

title: Biotic & Abiotic Sort
description: Sort 16 illustrated ecosystem cards into biotic and abiotic groups in a field notebook. Choose a picture and a group, or drag it, with helpful feedback after each choice.
grade_note: Practises identifying biotic and abiotic components; does not model the full ecosystem relationships.

title: Animal Diets Sort
description: Sort real animal photographs in two wildlife notebook challenges, using clues and explanations.
grade_note: Herbivore, carnivore and omnivore classification is explicitly Grade 3 content.

title: States of Matter Sort
description: Sort everyday examples and exact particle models into solids, liquids and gases.
grade_note: Everyday states support Grade 3 changes of state; the separate particle pictures support Grade 5 particle models.

title: Transparent & Opaque Sort
description: Sort clear materials and opaque objects in a colourful light notebook.
grade_note: The transparent/opaque comparison is a Grade 2 light-and-materials task; it does not cover Grade 9 wave behaviour.

title: Renewable Energy Sort
description: Sort ten energy sources by whether they are replenished naturally on human timescales.
grade_note: Renewable versus non-renewable classification supports part of both energy-resource outcomes; it does not assess energy-use tradeoffs.

title: Weather & Climate Sort
description: Use explicit timescale clues to distinguish short-term weather from long-term climate patterns.
grade_note: The activity distinguishes short-term weather from long-term climate, rather than modelling climate change.

title: Natural & Processed Materials
description: Sort twelve clearly pictured materials by whether people have manufactured or substantially changed them.
grade_note: Both grade tabs explicitly distinguish natural from processed materials.

title: Renaissance Atlas
description: Build a historical atlas with rich blue seas, medieval territories, city stars and Renaissance routes. LIAM mode uses two large choices and simple phrase responses.
credit: Engaging Students · classroom Renaissance mapping assignment
grade_note: Historical enrichment about medieval/Renaissance Europe. These activities are useful with the existing classroom assignment, but the supplied new Grade 8 workbook focuses on ideologies and economic/political systems, not the Renaissance. No new-workbook grade match is claimed.

title: Renaissance Atlas: Illustrated Map
description: Explore a fully labeled illustrated map of medieval Europe, then try three map questions with place names hidden. LIAM mode offers two large answer buttons.
credit: Engaging Students · historical geography and illustrated atlas artwork
grade_note: Historical enrichment about medieval/Renaissance Europe. These activities are useful with the existing classroom assignment, but the supplied new Grade 8 workbook focuses on ideologies and economic/political systems, not the Renaissance. No new-workbook grade match is claimed.

title: Railways & Immigration in Canada
description: Explore Canadian railways, immigration and population from 1867–1914. Move the year flag to see changing borders and railway routes, switch map layers, and investigate historical posters.
credit: Original artwork and historical content: LearnAlberta
grade_note: The 1867–1914 railway, settlement and immigration investigation fits post-Confederation Grade 7.

title: River Routes: Fur Trade Adventure
description: Pack a canoe, paddle, portage and bargain at illustrated fur-trade posts. Carry your cargo from Fort William to Rainy Lake.
credit: Classroom idea: Darren Maltais
grade_note: The games model parts of fur-trade exchange and travel. Historical relationships and impacts need classroom discussion beyond the game mechanics.

title: Trading Post: The Fur Trade Fair
description: Roll your starting goods, bargain across the trading counter and discover what your trades bring home. Two illustrated rounds.
credit: Inspired by a McCord Stewart Museum classroom activity
grade_note: The games model parts of fur-trade exchange and travel. Historical relationships and impacts need classroom discussion beyond the game mechanics.

title: Levels of Government Sort
description: Sort responsibilities among Canada's municipal, provincial and federal governments.
grade_note: The simplified leader/service sorts support introducing the three levels, comparing Alberta governments and revisiting roles in Grade 6 democracy.

title: Wants & Needs Sort
description: Sort 14 colourful picture cards into everyday needs and fun wants. Drag, tap or use the keyboard, check your choices, and discuss how circumstances can change the answer.
grade_note: Distinguishing needs and wants supports the Grade 1 exchange-of-goods-and-services topic.

title: Trade & Resources Sort
description: Classify examples about trade and resources, then check your decisions.
grade_note: Use goods/resource distinctions in Grade 1, Canadian resources in Grade 2 and Alberta resource use in Grade 3.

title: Natural Resources: Resource Depot
description: Stock a Minecraft-style depot by matching resources to industries. Then sort resources and products separately from tools and equipment. Two challenges with clues and explanatory feedback.
grade_note: Matching resources/products to industries supports Canada’s physical-region resources and Alberta resource use.

title: Sorting Game Builder
description: Build a custom card sort, add optional images, and test the student game. Download the complete game or a project you can edit later.
grade_note: Teacher-created or community-building content; choose prompts appropriate to the class. No fixed curriculum coverage is claimed.

title: Integer Operations Explorer
description: Build integer equations, cancel zero pairs with visual chips, follow a number line that expands to fit, and practise all four operations.
grade_note: Grade 6 introduces signed values and addition/subtraction; all-four-operation practice extends to Grade 7.

title: Make the Amount
description: Drag Canadian coins and bills into the box to build a target amount, then check your work.
grade_note: Use selected same-denomination or whole-dollar amounts for Grades 2–3; mixed cents and decimal totals are Grade 4 work.

title: Base 10 Blocks
description: Build numbers with place-value blocks and explore regrouping.
grade_note: Composing, decomposing and regrouping natural numbers match Grades 2–3; choose a number range appropriate to the grade.

title: Rational Numbers Explorer
description: Connect fractions, decimals and negative numbers using visual models and practice.
grade_note: Fraction/decimal relationships and number-set classification fit rational-number and real-number work.

title: Ordering Rational Numbers
description: Compare rational numbers and arrange them in order.
grade_note: Ordering signed fractions and decimals connects to the Grade 7 positive/negative number line and Grade 8 rational values.

title: Irrational Numbers Explorer
description: Explore square roots, irrational values and their locations on a number line.
grade_note: Classifying rational/irrational numbers supports Grade 8 introductions and Grade 9 real-number subsets.

title: Rational or Irrational?
description: Sort number expressions into rational and irrational groups.
grade_note: Classifying rational/irrational numbers supports Grade 8 introductions and Grade 9 real-number subsets.

title: Real Number Drop
description: Move the basket to catch falling numbers that belong to the target number category.
grade_note: Classifying rational/irrational numbers supports Grade 8 introductions and Grade 9 real-number subsets.

title: Perfect Squares & Cubes
description: Explore squares and cubes with models, then connect them with roots.
grade_note: Perfect squares/cubes are direct Grade 7 content; square-root models support Grade 8 roots.

title: Exponent Explorer
description: Explore powers, connect repeated multiplication with exponents, and practise exponent rules.
grade_note: Select the level: basic powers for Grade 6, squares/cubes for Grade 7, algebraic powers for Grade 8, and quadratic/exponent applications for Grade 9.

title: Polynomial Explorer
description: Model polynomial expressions and explore how terms combine.
grade_note: Grade 8 algebraic terms provide the entry point; polynomial operations are Grade 9 draft content.

title: A Year in the Life
description: Make financial decisions across a simulated year and see how choices affect a budget.
grade_note: The activity explicitly targets Grade 7 financial decision making. The supplied Math 7–9 workbook does not establish a direct budgeting outcome; keep it as enrichment until the financial-literacy curriculum is reviewed.

title: Ocean Counting Explorer
description: Count sea creatures, compare groups, and solve picture-based addition and subtraction stories. Includes tap-to-count, gentle hints, optional narration, and numbers to 10 or 20.
grade_note: Counting to 20, comparing groups and picture addition/subtraction align directly with Grade 1.

title: What's the Angle?
description: Estimate angles without a scale, build and measure angles, identify angle types, and solve missing-angle and triangle challenges. Six modes with touch, mouse and keyboard controls.
grade_note: Compare angles in Grade 3, measure and name them in Grade 4, and use triangle-angle relationships in Grade 8.

title: Forest Math Adventure
description: Help Bear, Owl and Squirrel follow woodland number trails! Count forwards and backwards, skip-count, complete patterns, and solve illustrated addition and subtraction stories in short five-round adventures.
credit: Original activities by Chantelle
grade_note: Choose range and trail: counting and stories within 20 in Grade 1, wider counting/patterns in Grade 2, and skip-counting sequences in Grade 3.

title: Pattern Detective
description: Spot mistakes in patterns, sort odd and even numbers, and follow number paths.
grade_note: Even/odd classification is explicit in Grade 2; identifying and repairing numerical sequences supports Grade 3.

title: Space Math Explorers
description: Complete four illustrated space missions! Share crystals equally between rockets, group astronauts into teams, count moon rocks, and solve galaxy addition equations with tap or drag controls.
credit: Original activities by Chantelle
grade_note: Count and add in Grade 1, share/group collections in Grade 2, and connect equal groups to division in Grade 3.

title: Science Inquiry Builder
description: Build a science investigation around a curriculum outcome and choose from several activity formats.
grade_note: A teacher planning tool for Grades 7–9. Built-in topic/outcome banks must be checked against the supplied September 2026 draft; no draft outcome coverage is claimed here.

title: Interactive Plant Grower
description: Care for a virtual plant, step through growth at your own pace, and record observations about its needs. Save notes and export the growth log.
grade_note: Care choices and observations support needs in Grade 1 and growth/development in Grade 2. Percentages are fictional game rules.

title: Interactive Creature Care
description: Care for the original virtual bear, observe its needs, and step through growth. Record notes and export the observation log.
grade_note: Care choices and observations support needs in Grade 1 and growth/development in Grade 2. Percentages are fictional game rules.

title: STRATA: Alberta Field Excavation
description: Excavate eight Alberta sites, inspect real fossil photographs, and save observations, evidence checks and comparisons in your field notebook.
grade_note: Alberta fossil sites and evidence notes match Grade 3 fossil investigations and Grade 8 geological-history content.

title: Life Cycles
description: Arrange stages to show how living things grow and change.
grade_note: Sequencing butterfly, frog and tree stages directly matches the Grade 2 life-cycle expectation.

title: Seasons Explorer
description: Sort twelve seasonal observations in an Alberta nature notebook.
grade_note: Sorting seasonal observations directly supports Grade 1 environmental and organism changes.

title: Food Chain Challenge
description: Build food-chain connections using organisms found in Alberta.
grade_note: Builds simple local food chains. Older-grade food-web and energy-pyramid outcomes need more than this linear-chain activity.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: Enter weather observations and create a forecast dashboard.
grade_note: Entering weather observations supports the weather-data part of Grade 5 climate study; a single forecast does not establish climate.

title: Ionic Nomenclature
description: Practise connecting ionic compound names and chemical formulas.
grade_note: Designed as Chemistry 20 (Grade 11). Binary ionic naming can extend Grade 9 draft work, while multivalent and polyatomic cases may go beyond it.

title: Alberta's Boundaries
description: Read about Alberta’s physical and political boundaries, investigate four vocabulary terms, and answer questions using evidence from the passage.
grade_note: The fixed passage compares Alberta’s physical and political boundaries, directly supporting Grade 3.

title: Civilizations of the World
description: Explore the locations and curriculum connections of ancient civilizations.
grade_note: Choose ancient civilization and trade-route content for Grade 5. Some additional regions/time periods are extensions beyond the named examples.

title: Port Royal Map
description: Explore Port Royal and use its map to investigate a historic settlement.
grade_note: Port-Royal is explicitly named in Grade 4 pre-Confederation settlement content.

title: Civilizations & Trade Routes
description: Explore ancient civilizations and major trade routes, including the Silk Road and the Royal Road.
grade_note: Choose ancient civilization and trade-route content for Grade 5. Some additional regions/time periods are extensions beyond the named examples.

title: Canadian Geography Hub
description: Explore and practise Canadian geography through several map-based challenges.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Canada Provinces Colouring Page
description: Print an outline map of the provinces and territories for colouring and labelling.
grade_note: Locating Canada’s provinces, territories and major cities supports the mapping portion of Grade 2 physical-region study. Capital memorization and route challenges are extensions, not the whole region outcome.

title: Canada Regions Colouring Page
description: Print an outline map of Canada’s physical regions for colouring and discussion.
grade_note: Canada’s physical regions are an explicit Grade 2 topic; use maps to compare regions, not only memorize names.

title: Numbered Treaties: Alberta Focus
description: Explore numbered treaty areas with a focus on Alberta.
grade_note: Grade 3 locates Alberta treaties; Grade 7 connects numbered treaties to post-Confederation state building. A treaty-area map alone does not teach the full treaty relationship.

title: Place Names of Alberta: Grade 3
description: Explore the stories behind Alberta place names in a visual, student-friendly map activity.
grade_note: The place-name stories and community languages support Alberta identity and historically significant places.

title: Social Studies 7–9 Activities
description: Choose from 22 illustrated activity buttons, grouped by grade: sorting, matching, sequencing, comparisons and spectrum tasks for Social Studies 7–9.
grade_note: The hub contains separate sets for each grade: Canada since Confederation, ideologies/systems, and modern Canada. Tagging the collection does not establish coverage of every outcome.

title: Canada Through Time: Changing Boundaries
description: Explore 23 historical maps from 1867–2003. Play the timeline, compare earlier boundaries, and select provinces, territories and historical districts to investigate how Canada changed.
credit: Boundary data: Natural Resources Canada
grade_note: The 1867–2003 timeline directly supports post-Confederation boundary changes.

title: Canada Through Time: Homelands, Colonies & Confederation
description: Explore 30 dates from before 1600 to 2003. Select digital colonial regions, compare changing boundaries and investigate French and British claims, the Royal Proclamation, the Quebec Act and Confederation. Opens at 1867; early boundaries are generalized classroom reconstructions.
credit: Sources: Atlas of Canada / Natural Resources Canada and historical references
grade_note: Earlier colonial maps support Grade 4; the Confederation and later timeline supports Grade 7. Early boundaries are generalized classroom reconstructions.

title: Ideology Spectrum Analyzer
description: Place ideas and choices on a spectrum between individualism and collectivism.
grade_note: Individualism and collectivism are explicit in the new Grade 8 ideology study.

title: Cultural Contact: Perspectives
description: Follow a decision journey through different perspectives on contact between European explorers and Indigenous peoples.
grade_note: Pre-Confederation contact, colonization, trade and perspectives connect to Grade 4. Some branches discuss later impacts and need contextual teaching.

title: Government Leaders & Responsibilities
description: Sort government leaders and services into separate federal, provincial and municipal categories.
grade_note: The simplified leader/service sorts support introducing the three levels, comparing Alberta governments and revisiting roles in Grade 6 democracy.

title: Systems of Government
description: Explore democracy in Canada through an interactive government activity.
grade_note: The activity is labelled Grade 6 and explains democracy, the Crown and government roles; the level/leader sections also support Grade 2 introductions.

title: Symbols of Alberta Memory Game
description: Turn over cards and match Alberta's symbols.
grade_note: Alberta symbols and general Alberta knowledge support selected identity, land and government content; the quiz is review, not a complete grade assessment.

title: Alberta Millionaire Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of Alberta in a multiple-choice quiz challenge.
grade_note: Alberta symbols and general Alberta knowledge support selected identity, land and government content; the quiz is review, not a complete grade assessment.

title: Knowledge Spark
description: Read, organise ideas, and show what you know about a Social Studies topic.
grade_note: The built-in reading topics explicitly reference changes in Canada’s political boundaries and the formation of Canada.

title: Image Spark
description: Look closely at an image, gather observations, and develop questions and interpretations.
grade_note: Teacher-selected ideas, images, terms and questions determine the grade and subject. The comparison/discussion tool alone does not cover a curriculum outcome.

title: Venn Diagram Sorting
description: Sort animal cards by whether they swim, fly, or do both, using an overlapping Venn diagram.
grade_note: Teacher-selected ideas, images, terms and questions determine the grade and subject. The comparison/discussion tool alone does not cover a curriculum outcome.

title: Two Truths and a Lie
description: Create and present a two-truths-and-a-lie activity for discussion and review.
grade_note: Teacher-created or community-building content; choose prompts appropriate to the class. No fixed curriculum coverage is claimed.

title: Learn About My Friends
description: Build a classroom question activity that helps learners share and get to know one another.
grade_note: Teacher-created or community-building content; choose prompts appropriate to the class. No fixed curriculum coverage is claimed.

title: Science Video Script Builder
description: Move source ideas into scenes and develop a video script about particle theory.
grade_note: The built-in script source concerns particle theory, supporting Grade 5 models and Grade 6 heating/cooling explanations.

title: DocuClear
description: Extract text from a PDF into a clearer reading view.
grade_note: Access, communication and routine support across grade levels. These tools are not subject-content coverage.

title: AAC Communication Board
description: Use a visual communication board to express needs and ideas.
grade_note: Access, communication and routine support across grade levels. These tools are not subject-content coverage.

title: Yes / No Board
description: Use large yes and no choices to support communication.
grade_note: Access, communication and routine support across grade levels. These tools are not subject-content coverage.

title: Visual Schedule
description: Build and follow a sequence of visual activities for the day.
grade_note: Access, communication and routine support across grade levels. These tools are not subject-content coverage.

title: Bee-Bot Adventure
description: Plan a route and test a sequence of movement commands on a grid.
grade_note: Planning, testing and revising movement-command sequences connect to early computer science. The games do not teach all coding/design expectations.

title: Code & Go Maze
description: Plan a route through a maze and use movement commands to reach the goal.
grade_note: Planning, testing and revising movement-command sequences connect to early computer science. The games do not teach all coding/design expectations.

title: Tale-Bot Adventure
description: Create a sequence of commands and guide Tale-Bot across an activity grid.
grade_note: Planning, testing and revising movement-command sequences connect to early computer science. The games do not teach all coding/design expectations.

title: Three-Minute Italian
description: Practise Italian words in a short vocabulary session.
grade_note: Language proficiency and learner needs determine use. These are not direct matches to the requested English language arts workbook or an audited additional-language curriculum.

title: Spanish Spark
description: Build Spanish words and phrases, match vocabulary, and practise a mix of questions.
grade_note: Language proficiency and learner needs determine use. These are not direct matches to the requested English language arts workbook or an audited additional-language curriculum.

title: Français Québec Practice
description: Practise French vocabulary and useful language in a Québec-focused learning tool.
grade_note: Language proficiency and learner needs determine use. These are not direct matches to the requested English language arts workbook or an audited additional-language curriculum.

title: English Learning Game
description: Practise English vocabulary through a game with visual choices.
grade_note: Language proficiency and learner needs determine use. These are not direct matches to the requested English language arts workbook or an audited additional-language curriculum.

title: English Practice for Chinese Speakers
description: Practise everyday English with support for Chinese-speaking learners.
grade_note: Language proficiency and learner needs determine use. These are not direct matches to the requested English language arts workbook or an audited additional-language curriculum.

title: Function Machine Detective
description: Study input/output tables, test equivalent rules, and predict a new output. Build your own machine and print a classroom challenge.
credit: Original idea: Tyler Walker · Improved classroom edition: Engaging Students
grade_note: Input/output tables and rule predictions support Grade 6 functions, Grade 7 function representations and Grade 8 linear equations. The app does not cover every graphing expectation.

title: Bridge Test Lab
description: Start with a car and a road-only deck. Build your own supports and unlock 12 challenges, from heavier vehicles to truss, beam, arch, suspension and gusty-wind missions. Use design hints, meet each budget and compare saved trials.
credit: Original idea: Tyler Walker · Improved classroom edition: Engaging Students
grade_note: Grade 7 structures are the direct science fit. Grades 4–5 design and Grade 8 design testing are additional partial connections; the simulation is not a real structural engineering model.

title: Ready, Set, Roll!
description: Predict, roll and compare two realistic toy cars. Six picture-led investigations explore surfaces, speed and ramp heights, with replay and a free-play rolling lab.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Grade 1 Science: compare how surfaces and ramp height affect rolling movement and speed. This is a partial connection to movement investigations; it does not cover every pathway, animal movement or influence on motion.

title: Plural Pattern Lab
description: Build plurals, sort words by spelling pattern, and revisit words that need practice. Includes irregular contrasts and printable word pairs.
credit: Original idea: Tyler Walker · Improved classroom edition: Engaging Students
grade_note: Regular s/es patterns fit Grades 1–2; irregular forms and complex plurals connect to Grades 3–4. Select the relevant pattern group.

title: Bend, Stretch, Change!
description: Squeeze a sponge, squish clay, stretch a rubber band and bend a pipe cleaner. Predict which materials spring back, then test and observe.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Grade 1 Science: observable material properties and changes in shape under gentle forces. This focused, illustrative investigation does not cover the full materials learning outcomes.

title: Magnet Workshop
description: Investigate magnetic poles, distance and materials, then freely sweep a magnet across a table to pick up steel objects and leave non-magnetic ones behind.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Alberta Grade 4 Science: investigate magnetism as a non-contact force, the attraction and repulsion of poles, the effect of distance, and selected magnetic materials. This is an illustrative, partial coverage of non-contact forces.

title: Vibration Station
description: Tune three matching strings independently, hear how tension changes pitch, and explore string vibration and longitudinal air movement in separate slow-motion views. Compare pitch, volume and duration with real generated audio.
credit: Engaging Students · Black Gold School Division
grade_note: Alberta Grade 2 Science: sound is made by vibrating objects. Explore pitch (high/low), volume (loud/quiet), and duration (short/long), plus sources of sound. A focused partial coverage of the Light and Sound learning outcome.
